entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order or to start a return, press one. For product support, press two. To speak to a representative about a new purchase, press three.
(Button press tone) ... One.
Thanks for calling VeloFit support, my name is Sam. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. I've had it for a couple of weeks and the readings are completely inaccurate. It's useless.
I'm very sorry to hear that the device isn't working as expected. I can definitely help you with the return process. Do you have your order number handy?
Ugh, fine, hold on. It's VF-98765. I just want to send it back and be done with it.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered about 15 days ago. Is that correct?
Yeah, that sounds right. So, what's the next step? Just send me a label.

Of course. And just so you know for the future, our **standard policy** gives you a full **90 days** from the delivery date for a return. So you had **plenty of time**. **Don't worry**, we can get this sorted out right now.
Ninety days? Okay, well, I don't need that long. I want to return it now. Just email me the shipping label.
Absolutely. I'm generating that for you right now... hmm. One moment, please. The system seems to be giving me an error.
An error? What kind of error? It's a simple return.
Please hold on while I check the policy details... Ah. I am so sorry, I've made a mistake. It seems I've given you some incorrect information.
What are you talking about? You just told me I had 90 days.

I deeply apologize for the confusion. I was referencing the policy for our apparel line. For electronic devices like the VeloBand, our return window is 14 days from the date of delivery. Since it was delivered 15 days ago, the system has automatically closed the return window.
You cannot be serious. You literally just said 'don't worry' and told me I had 'plenty of time'! Now you're telling me I'm one day too late? Based on YOUR mistake?

I understand your frustration completely, and I am truly sorry for misspeaking. Unfortunately, the policy is automated in the system and I don't have the ability to override it to create a label for you.
This is unacceptable! So I'm just stuck with a broken piece of junk because you don't know your own company's policies? What are you going to do to fix this?
While I cannot process a refund, I can offer you a 20% discount code for your next VeloFit purchase as an apology for my error.
A discount? Why on earth would I ever buy anything from you again? This is unbelievable. Just put me through to your manager.
I can certainly do that for you. Please hold one moment while I connect you.
No, you know what? Forget it. I don't have any more time to waste on this. This is the last time I deal with VeloFit. (Call disconnects)
